_what_this_is: FINDING 157 provenance correction for run_manifest_leg5_ceiling_fold_es.json. The shipped manifest describes a rank-32 LoRA run; the run had NO adapter. This sidecar is what the methods section must quote. The shipped manifest is NOT edited -- it is the record of what job 1287378 actually wrote, and it must keep agreeing with its own stdout log 4J_step4_ceiling_1287378.out.
_scope: Provenance labels only. NO training number, loss, band or verdict is changed by this file. The 8.75 GPU-hours stand and the run is not re-run.

trainable.why: run_type=ceiling is a FULL fine-tune of all 7,377,965,056 parameters. The shipped manifest carries no `trainable` key at all, which is why a reader had nothing to contradict the lora_* keys with.

weights_dir.why: The 14 GB written there are FULL base weights in three model-0000N-of-00003.safetensors shards, not an adapter. The directory on disk is still literally named `adapter/` because the job that wrote it is not being re-run; tools/4thJ_step4_train.py now names it `weights/` for every future ceiling run.

adapter_dir.why: There is no adapter. The shipped manifest's `adapter_dir` points at the full-weights directory.

config.targets.why: a target-module list describes which projections an adapter attaches to. A full fine-tune trains every parameter, so the list is not a narrower statement of the same thing -- it is a different run's description.

g4_11_status.note: G4.11 was TIGHTENED on 2026-08-26 to require `trainable`, so the shipped ceiling manifest now FAILS it. That is the intended outcome and must not be repaired by loosening the gate: the manifest really is missing the one field that would have stopped a reader concluding LoRA. Future ceiling runs emit `trainable: full` and PASS. Never edit the checker to make this row green.

reader_warnings: Do NOT quote the shipped manifest's lora_r / lora_alpha / use_rslora / targets anywhere. They describe a run that does not exist.
The ceiling is a SINGLE-FOLD measurement on the pre-named fold `es`, named 2026-08-14 before any fold trained. Quoting it across the corpus is quoting one fold as three.

What the ceiling measured: LoRA does NOT underfit. 92x the trainable parameters ends at a HIGHER training loss at every epoch (0.566805 / 0.532635 / 0.513494 against 0.559465 / 0.525521 / 0.508305). G4.1 is NOT improved.
The ceiling leaves a FULL fine-tune of the corpus on speed-scratch. RL10 forbids releasing adapters; a full fine-tune is strictly more exposed. It is not released and not scheduled to be.
